<thought>To find the template that performs nitro‑to‑amine reduction, I’ll search the template catalog for reactions that break a nitro group and form a primary amine. I’ll use a simple aromatic amine (aniline) as the target molecule SMILES, since the exact substrate isn’t provided.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)N",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
